summary: Red Bull's Isack Hadjar returns from a three-race wrist injury layoff determined to reclaim momentum in the championship battle at Baku's high-speed street circuit. The Azerbaijani Grand Prix's tight urban layout and heavy braking zones will test whether Hadjar's recovery allows him to match his rivals' pace immediately or if ring rust costs valuable points. A strong performance here could reshape the title fight, while a sluggish return would hand his competitors a decisive advantage heading into the season's final stretch.
